messages:
jess_support: Heads-up — customer reported blank metrics in Console for their Private VPC deployment. Ticket #12345. Dashboard shows 'No data' for last 24h. tenant=ten-8732, deployment=onprem-us-west-2-01. Anyone seen this pattern?

marta_custsu: Put their repro steps in the ticket: UI -> Project -> Metrics -> empty. They also queried the metrics API and got HTTP 200 with empty series. Link: https://redwood/support/ticket/12345

raj_oncall: looking now. Did they roll any ingress/auth changes recently?

jess_support: They mentioned an "auth-proxy swap" yesterday, around 2026-03-15 18:10 UTC.

diego_infra: I pulled sidecar/ingress logs around that time. See sample from proxy access log — header list shows no X-Redwood-Tenant: 

```
[2026-03-15T18:10:12Z] GET /v1/metrics 200 "upstream_headers": {
  host: "metrics.internal"
  x-request-id: "req-abc123"
}
```

No tenant header present.

ingrid_prod: That matches the symptom we've seen before. The metrics pipeline filters by tenant header; if the header's stripped upstream, queries return empty series in Console.

raj_oncall: Can the customer run a curl from their bastion to confirm header propagation? Example: 

```
curl -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: ten-8732" https://private-console.internal/api/metrics
```

marta_custsu: They ran that and attached proxy logs: curl returns 200 but metrics empty; proxy log still shows X-Redwood-Tenant omitted from forwarded headers.

diego_infra: Likely the new auth proxy is either dropping headers or rewriting them. Quick workaround for nginx-style ingress: ensure `proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Tenant $http_x_redwood_tenant;` or enable `preserve_host_headers: true`. For our sidecar auth, there's a `pass-tenant-header` toggle we can ask them to enable.

jess_support: We shouldn't change their infra ourselves. We'll provide clear instructions. Any risk to enabling that toggle?

raj_oncall: Risk low but confirm token flow. Also check auth-proxy logs for tenant extraction errors — if JWT parsing fails the proxy might not emit header. Search for "tenant claim" or "missing claim".

diego_infra: Found auth-proxy log at 2026-03-15T18:10:14: `WARN tenant claim missing for token aud=internal` and a short stack about token parsing. That matches the swap window.

ingrid_prod: Root cause likely the auth-proxy rollout enabled strict audience validation and didn't map legacy tenant claim -> X-Redwood-Tenant for some tokens. Result: header not emitted, upstream metrics sees no tenant and returns empty. Fix is either revert strict audience check or make proxy set X-Redwood-Tenant from JWT claim again.

raj_oncall: I'll draft a one-line config they can toggle in their sidecar: set `REDWOOD_ALLOW_LEGACY_TENANT_CLAIMS=true` (or the equivalent env var) then restart sidecar. That should restore header emission without reverting the roll.

marta_custsu: Customer applied the env change and restarted sidecar at 2026-03-15T19:05 UTC. They reported metrics started to reappear but with ~30m delay/backfill.

jess_support: I can confirm Console now shows metrics for ten-8732 backfilled starting ~19:10 UTC. Marking ticket as resolved pending a post-mortem and a permanent config recommendation.

sre_bot: incident-tracker created INC-2026-03-15-tenant-routing Severity=P2 Owner=raj_oncall

diego_infra: :thumbsup: I will add an ingress alert to detect when >1% requests lack X-Redwood-Tenant header over a 5m window so we catch regressions early.

jess_support: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the customer with next steps and a short runbook for Private/VPC customers about tenant header preservation.
